The textures are in 4K. The textures for the alien’s skin, shirt, pants, and shoes have been separated for customizability. The textures for the skin, shirt, and pants were created procedurally. The texture for the shoes was designed from a seamless photo. Each texture contains a diffuse and a normal map.
Note:
-Feel free to modify the model, textures, or anything else for your application as you see fit.
-The textures are included in a zip folder. They are also shown in the previews.
-The FBX may generate an extra head bone. Simply delete the head bone to remove the issue. The model was designed in Blender and therefore converting the files may cause some unusual behavior.
-The Youtube preview is for demonstration purposes. The model does not come with the environment or animations seen in the video. The model also may have varying materials and textures compared to the video. View the preview photos to see what materials and textures come with the model.
-You may need to unzip the files and place them in a folder for the textures to appear correctly. You may also need to reapply the textures if they do not load properly in your 3D software of choice. 
-The model wears the shirt and pants. The model does not have any underlying features other than the natural color of it's skin. The model also does not have feet. The shoes are directly connected to it's ankles.
-Depending on the animations choosen, the model may slightly intersect with it's clothing. I suggest using shape keys or avoiding animations that does this. You may also choose to delete parts underlying the clothes that may intersect with them for certain animations.

description_text:
Hey guys, this is a sci-fi ish sword i've modelled. 1 mesh, everythings connected, no ngons. Quads and triangles. UV wrapped, no overlapping, you can check the UV's in the preview.
POLIS:Verts:  9.421Faces: 8.621Tris: 15.069
I used blender (eevee) to render the previews, i also used (CC ) HDRI to light the scene, without baked textures/lights. 
I used substance painter to make the textures. Textures:Base color (2048x2048)Metallic (2048x2048)Roughness (2048x2048)Normal (2048x2048)Bump (2048x2048)Emission (2048x2048)
For the emission, you'll have a black and white matte, so you can use that as an alpha and change the green emission to anything you'd like. If you want to use it in a game, make sure that you edit the emission map and change the white color to whatever color you want. If you leave it white, it will emit white.
If you have any request, you can message me, and I'll see what I can do for you. Peace out! Love ya!

description_text: This model is based on the 90's Optimus Prime Toy.  I have modified the original design to give some length in the arms and left out some detail to keep the poly counts lower.  I wanted to capture the main aspects of the toy since I did not have the actual toy to reference from.  I have included the PBR materials just in case it does not automatically plug them in.  I have seperated the rigged from the non-rigged blender file just in-case you do not need it.   The rigged file had some complications with auto-plugging in the materials so those need to be connected.    I have tested this model in Unreal Engine 4 and can confirm that the model loads in and works.  The glass material does not auto plug in  for Unreal from the fbx and will need to be connected. -refined geometry in the foot and ankle.  Some people were troubled with the faceted geometry before, so now it should print smoother

This products create to explore and make new invovative solution for prosthethic arm accesorries and support part.
The main concept of this products are to carry some metal parts and stuff with electro magnet system.
  - The power supply located inside in the Main Arm, if we need to carry some metal part, the power supply will on and activate the electro magnet system and then we can carry that's metal parts. 
When we want to put that's metal parts, the electro magnet system are off (power supply shutting down).

  - The Led are automatically on when the electro magnet system was on. And the Led off when electro magnet system was off (this is just like indicator light). 

  - I just imagine we must place the on/off button in somewhere on human body that's can easily reachable and use with another part of human body. Or we can put the on off cable that's can be directly connected and disconected with special movements like when the arm are bended this is will on and when the arm are back into the initial position this device will off. Or something like that.

My design direction is create products that's :

  - Simple 

  - Easy to use 

  - Suitable for veterans (safe, durable) 

  - Visually pleasing design

  - Functional

Kind of things do you envision being picked up with this tool is like :

  - The commonly magnet will use in daliy activities are to pick up the fallen needle or nail or some small metal parts with very easy.

  - To open the refrigenerator door, or some handle door that's made from metal.

  - Carrying stainless steel material like, stainless steel cup or another else 

  - Tidy up the house garage/warehouse/workshop, because in this place there is many metal stuff that's we can handle with this products.

  - Holding on the stair metal rail when we turn up and down the house stair 

  - Holding on the metal handrail when we in the mass transportation like train or bus.

  - Adjust the Jacket Zipper (Metal Zipper).

  - Open the metal box case. 

  - Many else.

  - We can explore any activities and another benefits that's need this system. We will know more function off this system when we try it and use it.

description_text:
Hey guys, my name is ian kelly and go by Kellyian. 
You will able to transform the nose in many shapes and sizes. This is all possible by clicking Object Data (its a emblem of a upside down triangle on the top right hand side of the screen). Now, you must scroll to SHAPE KEYS this where you find the control to customize the Nose on the screen.
You will have the:
Default nose (BASIS)Nose_SlopeNose_HumpNose_SkinnyNose_WideNose_BobbleNose_FlickNose_LoweredNose_RaisedNose_DroopNose_Vampire/Orc
Just move the slider with the wordValue for it in order it to work. Make your own combinations by selecting, other noses!
The model of the nose is sculpted with alpha brushes (skin textures on the nose, giving it high detail). They should bea veins and wrinkles brushes if you should add more detail of your own but on a IMPORTANT NOTE, it needs to be selected on default which would be BASIS or it will not work!
The multiresolution is subdivided by 4 this is creating a high vertices count but,  retopology and baking will lower the amount vertices by a great amount when your character is completed.You will not be able to reshape the nose on a low poly, so be sure you have the nose exactly how you would like it on the high poly model! 
Please, join us on our Facebook group Blender Character Artists

description_text:
A hand is a prehensile, multi-fingered appendage located at the end of the forearm or forelimb of primates such as humans, chimpanzees, monkeys, and lemurs. A few other vertebrates such as the koala (which has two opposable thumbs on each hand and fingerprints extremely similar to human fingerprints) are often described as having hands instead of paws on their front limbs. The raccoon is usually described as having hands though opposable thumbs are lacking.[1]
Some evolutionary anatomists use the term hand to refer to the appendage of digits on the forelimb more generally — for example, in the context of whether the three digits of the bird hand involved the same homologous loss of two digits as in the dinosaur hand.[2]
The human hand normally has five digits: four fingers plus one thumb;[3][4] these are often referred to collectively as five fingers, however, whereby the thumb is included as one of the fingers.[3][5][6] It has 27 bones, not including the sesamoid bone, the number of which varies between people,[7] 14 of which are the phalanges (proximal, intermediate and distal) of the fingers and thumb. The metacarpal bones connect the fingers and the carpal bones of the wrist. Each human hand has five metacarpals[8] and eight carpal bones.
Fingers contain some of the densest areas of nerve endings in the body, and are the richest source of tactile feedback. They also have the greatest positioning capability of the body; thus, the sense of touch is intimately associated with hands. Like other paired organs (eyes, feet, legs) each hand is dominantly controlled by the opposing brain hemisphere, so that handedness—the preferred hand choice for single-handed activities such as writing with a pencil, reflects individual brain functioning.
Among humans, the hands play an important function in body language and sign language. Likewise, the ten digits of two hands and the twelve phalanges of four fingers (touchable by the thumb) have given rise to number systems and calculation techniques.

A nose is a protuberance in vertebrates that houses the nostrils, or nares, which receive and expel air for respiration alongside the mouth. Behind the nose are the olfactory mucosa and the sinuses. Behind the nasal cavity, air next passes through the pharynx, shared with the digestive system, and then into the rest of the respiratory system. In humans, the nose is located centrally on the face and serves as an alternative respiratory passage especially during suckling for infantsActing as the first interface between the external environment and an animal's delicate internal lungs, a nose conditions incoming air, both as a function of thermal regulation and filtration during respiration, as well as enabling the sensory perception of smell.
Hair inside nostrils filter incoming air, as a first line of defense against dust particles, smoke, and other potential obstructions that would otherwise inhibit respiration, and as a kind of filter against airborne illness. In addition to acting as a filter, mucus produced within the nose supplements the body's effort to maintain temperature, as well as contributes moisture to integral components of the respiratory system. Capillary structures of the nose warm and humidify air entering the body; later, this role in retaining moisture enables conditions for alveoli to properly exchange O2 for CO2 (i.e., respiration) within the lungs. description_text:
The foot (plural feet) is an anatomical structure found in many vertebrates. It is the terminal portion of a limb which bears weight and allows locomotion. In many animals with feet, the foot is a separate organ at the terminal part of the leg made up of one or more segments or bones, generally including claws or nails.The human foot is a strong and complex mechanical structure containing 26 bones, 33 joints (20 of which are actively articulated), and more than a hundred muscles, tendons, and ligaments.[2] The joints of the foot are the ankle and subtalar joint and the interphalangeal articulations of the foot. An anthropometric study of 1197 North American adult Caucasian males (mean age 35.5 years) found that a man's foot length was 26.3 cm with a standard deviation of 1.2 cm.[3]
The foot can be subdivided into the hindfoot, the midfoot, and the forefoot:
The hindfoot is composed of the talus (or ankle bone) and the calcaneus (or heel bone). The two long bones of the lower leg, the tibia and fibula, are connected to the top of the talus to form the ankle. Connected to the talus at the subtalar joint, the calcaneus, the largest bone of the foot, is cushioned underneath by a layer of fat.[2]
The five irregular bones of the midfoot, the cuboid, navicular, and three cuneiform bones, form the arches of the foot which serves as a shock absorber. The midfoot is connected to the hind- and fore-foot by muscles and the plantar fascia.[2]
The forefoot is composed of five toes and the corresponding five proximal long bones forming the metatarsus. Similar to the fingers of the hand, the bones of the toes are called phalanges and the big toe has two phalanges while the other four toes have three phalanges each. The joints between the phalanges are called interphalangeal and those between the metatarsus and phalanges are called metatarsophalangeal (MTP).[2]
Both the midfoot and forefoot constitute the dorsum (the area facing upwards while standing) and the planum (the area facing downwards while standing).
The instep is the arched part of the top of the foot between the toes and the ankle.

description_text:
Maitreya Buddha
Maitreya (i.e. Maitreya Bodhisattva, also called Maitreya Bodhisattva mahasa) (Sanskrit Maitreya, Pali metteyya), which is translated as Tzu and transliterated as mereliya. In Mahayana Buddhist classics, Maitreya is often called ayido Bodhisattva mahasa. It is the successor of the Buddha Sakyamuni. In the future, Maitreya will be born and cultivated in the Saha world and become the next Buddha (also called Future Buddha) in the Saha world, That is, the fifth Buddha among the Thousand Buddhas, which is often called Maitreya Buddha when he comes to the next life. It is regarded as the originator of the school of idealism. Its huge ideological system is interpreted and promoted by Wuzhao Bodhisattva and Shiqin Bodhisattva. It is highly praised by Chinese Mahayana Buddhist masters Zhi Qian, dao'an and Xuan Zang. In some monasteries of Han Buddhism, it is common to see bare chested, open belly and smiling (or big belly bhikkhu) modeled on the cloth bag monk. As an expression of Dharma education in Buddhism, it means great quantity and great blessing, reminding the world to learn tolerance. The big belly can accommodate things that are difficult to accommodate in the world; Open your mouth and laugh at the ridiculous people in the world.

description_text:
This is a high- poly character made and rendered in Blender. 
It is 1.7m tall, real world scale. Base mesh was made with a plane, extruded, scaled and placed to create the body. Most obejcts except for the hair and shoes are joined. The clothes are one object. 
Corset was made using the torso of the base mesh itself by extruding, scaling and adding loops cuts. Lace and silver curves were made with curve modelling.
Dress was made from an edge loop taken from the upper hip of the base mesh. It too, was extruded and scaled appropriately. Details and swoops on the dress made by curve modelling. Gloves were made by the same process.
Shoes made with box modelling, they are simply a cube. 
Hair made with a scaled cyclinder converted to a curved, duplicated and placed over and over again.
Base mesh was texture painted, all the rest have materials added to them.
Contains a shape key for blinking which can be deleted.

description_text:
Photogrammetry based model of a blue whale (Balaenoptera musculus) mandible (jaw) bone. 
This bone is a part of a fragmentary skeleton of a blue whale located in the yard of Faculty of Veterinary Medicine of the National University of Life and Environmental Sciences of Ukraine (Kyiv, Holosiivskyi district). Raw model of the jaw was created in Agisodt Metashape. Retopology and filling holes in a raw model was performed in Blender. Concrete tiles and leafs are digitized as PBR materials with displacement maps using Grzegorz Baran’s workflow.

description_text:
This is a digital 3D printable model of a Anatomically Correct Human Skull based on a scan.This accurate skull replica is a perfect Halloween decoration, or simply a wall decoration/shelf display, cosplay prop, headphone holder…
The download contains pieces of the model ready to be 3D printed on a 200 mm print bed and also files that are not cut into smaller pieces. All cut parts are placed on the print bed as we would print them to save you time. The individual pieces need to be glued together.
*Check out our amazing realistic animal skull collection! *
SIZEAt 100% scale, the model’s dimensions are approximately:Width 95 mmLength 160 mmHeight 170 mmYou can scale the model as you wish but we can’t guarantee that at a much smaller size, the model will print well.
3D PRINTING SETTINGSWe recommend printing the skull on an SLA 3D printer to preserve as many of the details as possible, but it performs well on FDM as well!We recommend using these settings on FDM:– Layer height 0.1 mm– Infill 15%– Supports 45°
For parts that are tall but have a small base, we use a 10 mm brim for better bed adhesion.Printing settings will vary greatly depending on your specific printer.
Do you like the model and don’t have a 3D printer? There are lots of people who offer 3D printing services these days. Try searching for someone who offers them in your area.
This fan-made model was brought to life by 3Demon. We are a group of modeling and 3D printing enthusiasts based in Prague, Czech Republic. We’ve been making 3D printable models for more than a decade. We make a lot of cosplay accessories but we also make all sorts of interesting 3D models.

description_text:
Our ancient pre-human ancestor, Homo Erectus, populated Southern Europe about 1.4 million years ago and evolved into Neanderthal and modern humans.  I built this model by superimposing the head on a front, side, and top photographs of a Homo Erectus Skull.  Homo Erectus had a body shape almost like modern humans so I simply modified a regular body mesh to build the body. Based on the evidence available to me this is my best guess as to what he probably looked like. This character is a Homo Erectus adult male who was the alpha male of his small tribe. This old man and his tribe lived in Southern Europe about 1 million years ago. He is armed with a spear made from a maple tree sapling and ground to a needle-sharp point. Although not quite a good as a stone tipped spear which would come hundreds of thousands of years later, this hard wood spear was a formable weapon.  Homo Erectus successfully hunted big game and adapted to every ecosystem in Southern Europe.
This character is a story telling tool and you can use him in any script that calls for “CAVEMAN” or “ANCIENT HUMAN” or “PRE-HUMAN”. Although Homo Erectus probably did not speak I have included a complete set of lip-sync poses so you can use this character in scripts with dialogue.
Dress him in a blue suite, police uniform, or college professor outfit and have some fun with him. He would make a great sub-human villein.

description_text:
Dear friends,
We would like to express our sincere gratitude for using our assets, sharing your impressions, and providing feedback. Your support helps us grow and move forward.
As a token of appreciation and a small gift for the upcoming/past holiday, we have prepared this free pack for you.
Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
Warm regards, your ithappy team.   
KEY HIGHLIGHTS  
Includes: a Demo Scene, a Santa character with 27 thematic animations. Over 130 unique assets for building a house, interior, and environment.      
KEY FEATURES
  - 
Demo scene. A small location shown in the images: a gingerbread house, interior, Santa, and environment assembled from unique assets.
The models are anatomically accurate and can be used both for games and medical projects. All objects include the necessary animations.

  - 
110 unique assets. Models for building the house, interior, festive Christmas atmosphere, and a small environment.

  - 
Santa. A Santa character model with 27 unique thematic animations, separate clothing pieces, individual facial assets (beard, mustache, glasses), and 9 different facial expressions.

  - 
Ease of Use. The pack includes two files with different Unity versions, and in each one, the scene is set up in three render pipelines. Simply download the version you need and open the scene in your preferred render pipeline. Everything is clear and easy to use.

  - 
Optimized Models. Lightweight meshes, few textures, and simple shaders ensure smooth performance on mobile, VR/AR, PC, and consoles while keeping visuals high-quality.

  - 
Support. Free updates and technical support available in our Discord (https://discord.gg/ithappy).

Demo SceneDemo scene — the location shown in the images.
It is a gingerbread house built from modular assets, so you can modify, rebuild, and customize it if needed.
Inside, there is a festive New Year interior on both the first and second floors.
The scene also includes a small surrounding environment in the form of a platform, made as a large round gingerbread, on which the house is placed.     
110 Unique Assets
  - 
Christmas Decorations
Christmas tree, wreaths, garlands, gift boxes, stocking, clock.

  - 
Fireplace & Fire
Fireplace, fireplace fire, decorative fire light.

  - 
Furniture & Interior
Bed, sofa, armchair, tables, nightstands, cabinets, kitchen furniture, stove, sink, lamps, rugs, bean bag.

  - 
Small Interior Props
Books, papers, paint jars, tools, cutlery, kitchen props.

  - 
Modular Gingerbread House
Walls, roof parts, doors, windows, icing elements, chocolate tiles, decorative details, gingerbread platform.

  - 
Winter Environment Props
Snow piles, snow elements, winter decorations, snowman.

Santa ClausAssets: hat, hair, glasses, mustache, beard, Santa coat, pants, gloves, boots
Animations include dances in various styles, basic movement (walking, running, fast running), jumps and acrobatic elements, idle animations, communication gestures, interaction with objects, greetings, and everyday actions.
You can also use animations from Mixamo, which offers more than 2,600 unique animations. Add them to your project by following this guide.    
FILES
You’ll be able to download formats such as Unity Package, UE, Blender, C4D, Maya, 3DSMax, FBX, OBJ, GLTF, and STL.       
COMPATIBILITY    

  - Blender 3.6+

  - Unity 2021.3+

  - Unity 6000+

  - Unreal Engine 4.20+

  - Unreal Engine 5.0+

  - Godot Engine 3.4+

  - Roblox

TECHNICAL INFO

Geometry:     

  - 128 Unique Assets

  - Santa with full outfit has 13.6k tris.

  - Materials: All models use 10 materials        

  - Textures: All models use 6 texture.

We would love to hear from you: support@ithappystudios.com
We aim to respond within 24 hours.      
Leave a review to help us improve and expand this character pack further! Your projects are the reason we create 3D models. We genuinely care about how you use our work, and we'd love to hear your thoughts on the pack.

Design
The design emphasizes recognizable anatomy with simplified geometry. Bones are proportioned for visual clarity rather than strict scientific accuracy, making the model ideal for games, educational visuals, and stylized scenes. The tusks are elongated and smoothly curved, serving as a strong focal point.
Style
Low-poly, stylized realism. The model balances realism and abstraction, avoiding excessive detail while preserving the character of a skeletal creature. Suitable for real-time rendering, mobile platforms, VR/AR, and background assets.
Form
Quadruped skeletal form with a long spine, visible rib cage, articulated limbs, and an oversized skull with tusks. The silhouette is clean and readable, with consistent topology across all parts.
Materials
Single material setup designed to resemble aged bone. Materials are simple and optimized, making the asset easy to integrate into different pipelines and lighting conditions.
Colors
Off-white, ivory, light beige, subtle brown discoloration. Neutral tones allow easy recoloring or material replacement.
Use Cases
Games, educational projects, museums, documentaries, fantasy or prehistoric environments, VR/AR experiences, cinematic background assets.

Skeletons Mini Set – 3 Models is a compact collection of highly detailed skeletal 3D assets inspired by prehistoric creatures and marine predators. The pack includes three distinct skeletons featuring different anatomical structures: a long-neck fantasy creature, a spiked deep-sea fish skeleton, and a large predatory fish skeleton.
The models are designed for cinematic scenes, fantasy environments, underwater worlds, museum displays, creature studies, archaeological scenes, and game environments. Each skeleton emphasizes clear bone structure and readable anatomy, making them useful both as environment props and as hero assets for close-up shots.
Design
The models are built with a strong focus on anatomical readability and dramatic silhouettes. Each skeleton highlights key structural components such as vertebrae chains, rib cages, skull cavities, jaw mechanics, and limb or fin frameworks.
The long-neck creature skeleton features an extended vertebral column with large rib structures and heavy limb bones, giving the appearance of a prehistoric or fantasy quadruped creature.
The spiked deep-sea fish skeleton includes exaggerated dorsal spines, elongated ribs, and a sharp skull structure typical of predatory deep-ocean species.
The large predatory fish skeleton is designed with a powerful jaw structure, prominent teeth sockets, large cranial cavity, and a fully articulated spine and fin system.
These variations allow the models to be used across multiple visual contexts including prehistoric scenes, underwater environments, fantasy worlds, and scientific visualizations.
Style
The skeletons follow a realistic anatomical style with slight stylized exaggeration to enhance visual clarity and silhouette strength. Bone shapes are carefully sculpted to maintain natural curvature while emphasizing structural detail.
The style works well in:

  - cinematic renders

  - documentary visualizations

  - fantasy or prehistoric environments

  - underwater scenes

  - museum or archaeological displays

  - creature design references

The clean bone structure also makes the assets suitable for lighting studies and close-up render shots.
Form
Each model presents a different skeletal structure:

  - Quadruped long-neck skeleton with large rib cage and extended vertebrae

  - Spiked fish skeleton with tall dorsal spines and thin rib formations

  - Predatory fish skeleton with strong jaw structure and large cranial bones

The forms vary from tall vertical structures to long horizontal bodies, allowing them to fill different scene compositions such as ground environments, underwater scenes, or display stands.
Materials
The models are optimized for standard PBR bone materials. Surfaces are suitable for applying realistic bone shaders with subtle roughness and micro-surface variation.
These assets are compatible with major rendering engines including Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, Maya, Cinema 4D, Houdini, V-Ray, Arnold, Redshift, and Octane...
Colors
The skeletons use natural bone coloration commonly found in fossil or preserved skeletal remains:

  - ivory

  - off-white bone

  - pale beige

  - light calcium tones

  - slightly aged yellowish highlights

The neutral palette allows the assets to integrate easily into different lighting environments such as underwater scenes, dark caves, museum displays, or fantasy landscapes.
Use Cases

  - underwater environment scenes

  - prehistoric landscapes

  - archaeological discoveries

description_text:
This was my entry for the Sketchfast 7 contest. Trevor from GTA 5 dressed like Freddy Krueger
The task was to model your favorite game character wearing a Halloween costume and the finished model had to be game ready, time limit 72 hours. Unfortunately, I have no favorite video game character, so I just decided to model this weird Trevor from GTA 5 wearing a Freddy Krueger costume. First, I searched a lot of reference pictures on the web, mainly high-resolution wallpapers and screenshots, then I started to model a High-Poly version to 1.200.000 triangles bake the normal and the ambient occlusion map on the UV of the Low-Poly version which has 8.233 triangles. You will find the Low-poly version of this charter on layer one and the High-Poly version on Layer six. All the modifiers I have used in the baking process are still present, I thought it might be interesting as an example for those who want to learn this bake technique.
All the diffuse maps would be drawn in Blenders Texture Paint Mode, no external 2D Image editing this time :) The Armature is very simple but functional.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U734U909ERs

description_text: This 3D model was originally created with Sketchup 8 and then converted to all other 3D formats. Native format is .skp 3dsmax scene is 3ds Max 2016 version, rendered with Vray 3.00 This is the Sears model 'Atlanta' from the 1930s.  Barely changed from the original floor plan.  The view is the same as the magazine view.  1 room added - a storage or laundry.  There is a hole in the wall for the washer hoses to connect to the sink faucets in the cabinet.  Bedrooms are small, kichen is original except for the refer and stove.  The hood vents to the original chimney where the old stove vented.  Cellar is divided into quarters : the back 2 are for the upstairs tenents, the front 2 are the downstairs tenants, accessed via the light well.  Landlord has upgraded the floors downstairs, upstairs still has the stinky old carpet and worn out flooring.  Maybe someday...  At least the rent is cheap upstairs.  More Sears houses to come.

description_text:
SummaryI wanted to make a project that was conceptually easy, but was also an insane undertaking.
And so, here is a life-size dress form, exploded into individual quads, which can be printed (standing up) on a Replicator1 build plate.
Abandon all hope, ye who enter here.
InstructionsWARNING:  dress-form.stl is not printable!  It's just to give you some idea of what the thing will look like when you put it together!
1: Print all 608 STLs.  This can be accomplished by loading them into ReplicatorG one at a time and pressing Lay flat so that their bottom edges are touching the build plate.  Once you've done that for all 608 files, you can plate them however you see fit using MakerWare, Blender, OpenSCAD, or whatever you prefer to use.
2: Glue them together.  The names of the files are however Blender named them, so you'll have no help in knowing what order to put them together in.  If anybody with better Blender-fu could make a derivative, I'd be much obliged.
3: Figure out some sort of stand to put them on.
4: Have an epic dress form, that's just for decoration.

description_text:
This is a generic fishing lure that has a flash skirt and a big teasing eye built entirely in quads.  As a child I use to fish with my dad in the Sea of Cortez every weekend in our boat.  These type of lures always did the trick to attract beautiful Sailfish, Marlin, and Dorado.  The part is built native in Cinema 4D R15 which uses the cloth tool and belt, in C4D place it in your animation and let the lure fly (ensuring that the object its hooked on has a cloth collider) and you will get a beautiful fish fight effect with this object.  Subdivision ready for all programs.
C4D model has the skirt spread open on frame 0, simply continue to play to get the simulation you desire.  For other programs the skirt is preset for a nice elastic appearance with a subdivision factor of 2.  Higher and lower res models available upon purchase (tell me how you want the skirt fashioned and I will send an updated file).  
C4D Model contains some textures and several materials for best effect.  Other programs the textures have all the same effects embedded but may need adjustment to achieve desired effect.  Add this to your favorite fishing scene or boat scene to add some great flare at little cost.
NOTE: This model is native to Cinema 4D, all renders were created using C4D R15 and may not reflect other programs in terms of materials. Polygons represent the low resolution C4D model (Available for other programs on request).
If this model meets or exceeds your expectations please comment and like. Happy Modelling!
If you like this model check out my others under jasoncrohr

description_text:
Update 2026 

  - Unity version: Verified and re-saved the project in Unity 2022.3.62f3 (LTS).

  - Rebuilt LOD system with unified mesh structure across all prefabs

  - glTF Files

  - Expanded and enriched the demo scene

  - Added new bus models for the Lost Bus set

  - Reorganized project structure for demo and asset review scenes

  - Added missing colliders to over 50 assets

  - Added 8 new stone structures to the Ground category

  - Added 2 new objects to the Root category

  - Added 2 new tree objects to the Plant category

  - Added 3 color variants of grass (category: Plants)

  - Added 3 color variants of cactus models (category: Plants)

  - Added 6 color variants of stone monolith structures (category: Ground)

Stylized low poly desert scene featuring a raft stranded in the sand, surrounded by nature and props for survival and exploration gameplay.
This pack includes over 80 handcrafted prefabs optimized for mobile and desktop, with 3 LODs and efficient poly count. It offers a cohesive visual style ideal for fast prototyping and stylized projects.
The download includes multiple file formats: UnityPackage, FBX (with and without LODs), glTF, and a native .blend file for Blender users. An Unreal Engine-ready ZIP is also included for legacy support. These flexible formats make it easy to integrate the assets into any workflow – whether you're prototyping in Unity, building scenes in Unreal, or customizing in Blender.
Contains 67 low poly models as fbx mesh files and ready-to-use prefabs. Contains **Unity **package, **Unreal **project and **Blender **file.

Many PBR pipelines have the accurate simulation of photorealism as their goal. Feasible and quick approximations of the bidirectional reflectance distribution function and rendering equation are of mathematical importance in this field. description_text: cap_Marvelous designer 9Marvelous designer 9A cap (fr. Chape from lat. Cappa - headdress) is a traditional headdress of Russian and other national costumes. In written sources, it is mentioned from the Spiritual Letter of Ivan Kalita from 1327-1328. The upper part of the Zbruch idol, dating from about the X century, is decorated in the form of a rounded hat with a fur edge. The cap consisted of a round cone-shaped tulle with a height of about 7 apices and a round fur band with a height of about 2 apices. The top of the tulle sometimes wringed on its side. An incision was made in the circumference of the front of the cap (and sometimes in the back), which was called the gap. The hat was widespread in all walks of life, and subsequently all hats began to be called a hat.
